item.title: Rallying Cry – October 5, 2026
item.description: The Aga Khan Foundation is investing $500 million to restore the Indian Ocean while turning it into an economic opportunity, Crumbl is teaming up with Make-A-Wish Canada to brighten kids' lives, and a stunning new 320-kilometer walking trail just opened in Japan.
